verdict.rationale: Bugbot applies the same action across many items mainly through automatic coverage. It reviews every PR once enabled (docs-1, docs-31, docs-28), can be connected to all repositories at once (docs-32), and admins can set organization-wide rules (docs-29). However, there is no evidence of user-initiated bulk actions: manual triggers are per-PR comments (docs-2), and fixes open one issue at a time (docs-3, docs-4). Missing for 10: bulk triggering or re-running reviews across many PRs, batch resolving or applying fixes for multiple findings, and any API or CLI for bulk operations, plus independent corroboration.
